d: In Bihar’s much-watched Mokama Assembly seat, all speculation has finally ended with a decisive mandate. Anant Kumar Singh has once again emerged victorious, defeating RJD candidate Veena Devi, wife of strongman Surajbhan Singh, by a massive margin of 28,206 votes. Piyush Priyadarshi of the Jan Suraaj Party finished third with 19,365 votes. These results have dismissed all predictions that suggested a tough road ahead for Anant Singh this time.
